Answer all questions.  For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Follow the instructions on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Write in soft pencil.  Write your name, centre number and candidate number on the multiple choice answer sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you.  Do not use correction fluid.  Do not write on any bar codes.  You may use a calculator. INFORMATION  The total mark for this paper is 30.  Each correct answer will score one mark.  Any rough working should be done on this question paper.
What is a characteristic of an indifference curve?

options.A: It will remain concave to the origin of the diagram.
options.B: It will remain convex to the origin of the diagram.
options.C: It can intersect other indifference curves at any point.
options.D: The lower the indifference curve, the greater the satisfaction attainable.

questions.questionText: A Belgian traffic study concluded that there would be significant benefits if 10% of car drivers switched to using motorcycles during peak traffic times. Which result would be considered a cost of this change?

options.D: reduced traffic queues

questions.questionText: The diagram shows a firm’s long-run average cost curve (LRAC). LRAC cost X Y O output What could explain the shape of the curve from X to Y?

options.A: a decrease in total fixed cost
options.D: more than one factor of production is variable

questions.questionText: The diagram shows the average revenue (AR) and average cost (AC) curves for a firm X that manufactures electronic goods. Firm X then completes a takeover of firm Y that supplies its component parts making them cheaper. The original average revenue and average cost curves of firm X are AR and AC .

LMN Ltd operates as a relatively small, family-owned producer in an industry dominated by a few large firms. Its product is unique so the owners are confident they will be able to sell enough to provide them with sufficient revenue to allow a minimum acceptable level of performance for the firm. Other than survival, what is the most likely objective of LMN Ltd?

options.D: sales maximising

questions.questionText: The diagram shows the short-run average cost, SRAC, and long-run average cost, LRAC, curves for a firm producing computers. It usually produces 2000 computers per week. An increase in demand requires the firm to produce 3000 computers per week. cost $ SRAC LRAC SRAC
What is a characteristic of monopolistic competition?

options.D: small number of buyers and sellers

questions.questionText: What is likely to have its cause in the separation of ownership and control in a firm?

options.D: prisoner’s dilemma

questions.questionText: Firms X and Y merge in a horizontal integration. What must be true about the industry and the stage of production in which X and Y operate? stage of industry production

options.D: same same

questions.questionText: Which government policy would not be classified as regulation?

options.B: compulsory wearing of seatbelts in cars
options.C: licences for the extraction of water from rivers
options.D: taxation of cigarettes

questions.questionText: A government removes a subsidy on a rural school bus service. What is the effect of this on the market for this bus service?

options.D: Social marginal costs decrease.

questions.questionText: The graph shows the percentage growth in average earnings for an economy. average wage growth % –2 –4 Jan April 2024 2024 What is the most likely cause of the pattern shown in the graph?

options.A: a decrease in the supply of labour
options.B: a decrease in the interest rate
options.D: an increase in the size of the labour force

questions.questionText: The table shows the output of chairs at a factory when different numbers of workers are employed. number of workers 0 1 2 3 4 5 number of chairs produced 0 7 17 26 34 40 When will diminishing marginal returns to labour set in?

options.A: when the second worker is employed
options.B: when the third worker is employed
options.C: when the fourth worker is employed
options.D: when the fifth worker is employed

questions.questionText: In the diagram, D represents the long-run demand curve for labour in a firm operating in an imperfect market. When there is a fall in the amount of capital invested per worker, the marginal revenue productivity of labour (MRP) curve shifts from MRP to MRP .
Which statement about money is correct?

options.A: It consists solely of deposits held by commercial banks.
options.B: It functions as a medium of exchange.
options.C: Its monetary value equals its production costs.
options.D: It operates only when there is a double coincidence of wants.

questions.questionText: In country X, unemployment is rising at the same time as the number of job vacancies is increasing. What is the most likely reason for this?

options.C: Geographical mobility of labour is rising.
options.D: Occupational immobility of labour is rising.

questions.questionText: An increase in which variable affecting labour markets is most likely to reduce the natural rate of unemployment?

options.D: the participation on training courses

questions.questionText: A consumer has an income of $1000 per week. The consumer spends 80% of this on goods and services. Following an increase in the consumer’s income to $1200 per week, consumption increases to $900 per week. Which statement is correct?

options.A: The average propensity to consume does not change.
options.B: The initial average propensity to consume is 5.
options.C: The marginal propensity to consume is 0.5.
options.D: The marginal propensity to consume is 2.

What is not an aim of macroeconomic policy?

options.D: satisfactory balance of payments

How could high interest rates increase a country’s rate of inflation?

options.A: by increasing the current borrowing costs of business
options.B: by increasing the current borrowing costs of government
options.C: by increasing the foreign exchange rate of the currency
options.D: by increasing the opportunity cost of spending

questions.questionText: What is most likely to influence subsequent increases in national income as a result of a government policy of reduced interest rates?

options.D: marginal utility

questions.questionText: Which policy to reduce a current account deficit on the balance of payments could be described as an expenditure-switching policy?

options.B: a decrease in the exchange rate of the country’s currency
options.C: an increase in domestic income taxes
options.D: an increase in domestic interest rates

questions.questionText: Which components are included in the financial account of the balance of payments? foreign direct interest, profits investment and dividends
It is often argued that the UN Human Development Index (HDI) is a better indicator of economic development than income per capita because it adjusts for

options.A: average hours worked by the population.
options.D: life expectancy at birth.

questions.questionText: Some conditions for providing foreign aid to low-income countries can be restrictive. Which kind of aid fits this description?

options.A: food aid in the event of natural catastrophes such as severe drought
options.B: grants that are tied to purchasing donor country goods
options.C: loans that are repaid over a long period at a low rate of interest
options.D: technical assistance using highly skilled worker transfers to provide support

questions.questionText: What is most likely to cause the living standards of a country to rise?

options.A: an increase in the number of doctors
options.B: an increase in the gold reserves
options.C: an increase in the number of people per house
options.D: an increase in the money supply
